paw_method: r2 repair(source, original), using its alpha_stage output; restore enclosed paw low-coverage Alpha and bounded local paw R/B chroma only.
alpha_method: Only explicit enclosed paw ROI coverage is restored; outside-paw Alpha, visible support, and zero-Alpha support are unchanged.
rgb_method: Paw-only source R/B chroma repair with source G preserved. Mane RGB pass is removed by using alpha_stage.

parameters.fallback_local_chroma: For enclosed paw low coverage only, relax the G difference exclusion; preserve G itself and weight G similarity. Same max7px radius, >=3 existing reliable source neighbors.
